decision.summary: A transient negative offset in N and U (indices ~412–424) is evident with sustained deviation and only partial recovery; E exhibits a delayed, weaker dip without confirmed opposing return within allowed context. The absence of a clear, coherent return on all affected axes prevents confirmation of a complete temporary offset interval.

intervals.observation: N and U show a multi-sample negative excursion (≈−2 to −3 MAD) starting near index 412, reaching minimum near 417–419, with partial but incomplete recovery by 424; E shows a weaker, delayed dip peaking ~420–422 without clear opposing return. No full reversal observed before end of allowed context (460).
